methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The energy baseline is essentially a reference point for the overall energy consumption of the organisation, which can be taken from a representative calendar year or a typical 12-month period. The energy consumption reference year could, under certain circumstances, coincide with the base reference year for GHG emissions, per the terms of the ISO 14064 standard. Next, the energy power indicators are defined; these reflect overall as well as detailed energy efficiency, compared with the energy baseline, on a monthly basis.
